title: Use a coercive weak inverse for a paid quadratic one-step law
statement: For square-integrable X:Gaussian R^n->R^d,delta B=X-mu,bounded B and bounded tau=B(DX)^T with sym tau>=cI,c>0,the symmetric maximal divergence graph has a unique variational S. With R=sym tau-I,r=||R||_2,u=delta(SB),one has||S||_2<=r/c,||u||_2<=r/(2sqrt(c)). A fresh reserve a>0 gives TV(X+u+aZ,N(mu,(1+a^2)I))<=min(1,C(a,c)r^2),C=sqrt(6)[1/a-arctan(1/a)]/(2sqrt(c))+sqrt(2)/(8ca^2).

requires: Bounded locally C1 B,locally Lipschitz X and bounded tau,or the stated closed horizontal calculus
Symmetric S with delta(SB) in L2;admissible localized Hessian test fields
provides: Coercive nonsymmetric Lax-Milgram form,global mean preservation and true smoothed full-law cancellation
No unproved full Du bound needed
Implemented unbiased Uhat replaces the quadratic remainder by its actual E||Uhat||^2;conditional bias and FULL equation residual have separate terms
assumptions: Matrix skew derivative/commutator is uncontrolled;not a matrix all-order iteration
For h(G)+Z,Lip(h)=ell<1:initial r<=sqrt(d)ell^2,so the bound is O(d ell^4)
costs: B,tau and variational solve are analytical fields,not legal value inputs
Reserve enlarges target covariance;cannot be free
Coefficient acquisition,full residual,variance and precision remain open
contract.units: Frobenius Gaussian-L2 residual and full marginal TV
contract.obstruction: Valid analytical one-step theorem,not an acquired universal compiler or practical advantage.
